decisions.reason: The aloe vera line has kept a dedicated page for two years, which signals that results meet aspirations, and it fits the firm's core natural facial care offer, so there is no shortfall to trigger problemistic search.

The hyaluronic serum has stayed listed in a growing industry and needs few extra resources because it is close to the established offer, though its low visibility leaves some uncertainty about whether it meets aspirations.

The cleansing oil appears to replace the dropped cleansing milk as the outcome of problemistic search within the cleansing segment, so management will give it time while its results are still uncertain.
